name: God With Us
overview: The Scriptures reveal the profound truth that God is continually present with His people, providing strength, courage, and help in every circumstance. From the Old Testament assurances in Joshua and Isaiah, where God promises His steadfast presence and support, to the joyful declaration in Zephaniah of God rejoicing over His people, the theme of divine nearness is clear. This promise reaches its fulfillment in the New Testament with the incarnation of Christ, called Emmanuel, meaning 'God with us,' who dwelt among humanity and continues to be present with His followers until the end of the age.
